entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Anyway, thanks for coming. Were you[n]hoping to see me today?
I want to see you every day.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Oh, okay. Then I guess we can just[n]call it here.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I'm joking. I wanted to see you too.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Well, then I can be honest too:[n]I'm glad to hear it.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: If you don't have anything in mind,[n]we can go out to eat. Don't worry,[n]no experiments today.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: This usually isn't my style, but it's[n]Christmas, so...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Would you like to hold hands?
